Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. ACME has a live DSR for one of our end users (access + deletion) and our legal/privacy team needs two things before we proceed with the deletion:

- A short description of Redwood's proof-of-deletion process and what evidence you can provide to show records were removed from backups/archives;
- A redaction sample: we need to confirm how PII is redacted in exported records (a small CSV sample is fine, with test data);
- Confirmation of whether Redwood acts as controller or processor for hosted API calls in our typical SaaS integration, and any implications for logging retention when acting as processor.

Can you send the CAIQ / SIG excerpt that covers DSRs and data retention too? Our security team (VendorSec) will cross-check.

We'd like to close this by EOD Friday if possible — ACME is on a short timeline.

Best,
Maria
Privacy Counsel, ACME Corp

Thanks Maria — we can support that. Looping in Rishi (Security/Privacy) and Priyom (Ops) to provide the artifacts and a short handoff checklist.

High-level answers up front:
- Controller vs Processor: For hosted Redwood API usage where ACME controls prompts and data sent to the API, Redwood operates as a processor by default; we offer a controller-mode option for Dedicated/Private deployments or when a contractual change is requested.
- Retention & logging: By default we retain request logs (metadata and partial token traces) for 30 days for debugging and abuse detection; retention can be shortened via contract and we support retention hold and expunge workflows tied to DSRs.
- Proof-of-deletion: We provide a deletion audit bundle showing the export id, deletion job id, timestamps, and a signed manifest; for backups we run a TTL-based purge and can provide an evidence statement describing backup retention windows and deletion timing.

What I'll send now: the Redwood DSR playbook (short PDF), a small redaction CSV sample (with synthetic values), and our CAIQ answers sheet highlighting relevant sections. Priyom — can you attach the CAIQ and the sample export? Rishi — confirm whether the DPA amendment draft is required for this case (ACME is enterprise).

Monica
Director, Field Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Maria / team — attaching the requested artifacts:
- CAIQ-answers-Redwood-2026.xlsx (filtered tabs: DSRs, Logging, Backups)
- redaction_sample_export-20260907.csv (synthetic data, shows redaction markers and hash placeholders)
- redwood_dsr_playbook_v1.pdf (Monica already attached)

Quick notes on the CSV sample: we replace direct identifiers with deterministic hashes (sha256 truncated) and a redaction reason code; the sample shows how an export looks prior to deletion and the post-redaction state. If you need different redaction formats (e.g., zero-knowledge tokens) we can produce that.

Regarding backups: our backups are encrypted and rotated daily; retention window is 90 days for hosted accounts by default. Deletion from backups follows the next retention cycle; we can provide a signed statement with the backup job ids and timestamps.

Maria — a few compliance details to highlight:
1) Controller/Processor: Confirming Monica's note — Redwood is processor for standard API usage. Where customers require controller status (e.g., Dedicated/Private) we offer contract language to reflect that operational separation.
2) DPA amendment suggestion: For enterprise customers who want explicit deletion guarantees from backups, we propose a short amendment clause (attached draft: DPA-amendment-draft.docx) that specifies backup retention limits and an escrowed audit manifest. Monica, Priyom — happy to iterate.
3) Evidence bundle content: we will include: export id(s), deletion job id(s), signed manifest (GPG), log snapshots showing deletion API calls, and a human-readable summary. For legal teams that need stronger guarantees, we can provide an indemnity-limited attestation letter.

If ACME needs the whole bundle before deletion, we recommend a temporary retention hold for the subject's data until they confirm deletion. That prevents race conditions.

Rishi
Head of Security & Privacy Operations
Redwood Inference
